description: Source code for the OperatorEntry class in PyTorch's dispatch mechanism, managing operator schemas, kernels, dispatch table updates, and error handling.

classes.name: OperatorEntry
classes.description: Manages operator schemas, kernels, dispatch table, and error handling within PyTorch's dispatch system.

methods.name: missingKernel
methods.description: Returns a static instance of an empty or missing kernel.

methods.name: ambiguousAutogradOtherKernel
methods.description: Returns a static kernel representing an ambiguous autograd kernel.

methods.name: assertSignatureIsCorrect
methods.description: Checks if the provided call signature matches the registered signature.

methods.name: registerSchema
methods.description: Registers an operator schema with validation against existing kernels.

methods.name: deregisterSchema
methods.description: Deregisters the current operator schema.

methods.name: registerKernel
methods.description: Registers a kernel for a specific dispatch key and updates the dispatch table.

methods.name: deregisterKernel_
methods.description: Deregisters a kernel for a specific dispatch key.

methods.name: updateFallback
methods.description: Updates the fallback kernel for a dispatch key.

methods.name: computeDispatchTableEntry
methods.description: Returns the kernel function for a given dispatch key.

methods.name: hasKernelForAnyDispatchKey
methods.description: Checks if any kernel exists for a set of dispatch keys.

methods.name: hasKernelForDispatchKey
methods.description: Checks if a kernel exists for a specific dispatch key.

methods.name: kernelForDispatchKey
methods.description: Returns the kernel function for a specific dispatch key.

methods.name: hasComputedKernelForDispatchKey
methods.description: Checks if a computed kernel exists for a dispatch key.

methods.name: getKernelForDispatchKey
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the kernel for a dispatch key if registered.

methods.name: getComputedKernelForDispatchKey
methods.description: Returns a SafeKernelFunction for a dispatch key if available.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns tags associated with the operator.

methods.name: computeDispatchTableEntryWithDebug
methods.description: Computes and returns the dispatch table entry with debug info for a dispatch key.

methods.name: updateDispatchTableEntry_
methods.description: Updates a single dispatch table entry for a dispatch key.

methods.name: updateDispatchTable_
methods.description: Updates dispatch table entries for a dispatch key and its aliases.

methods.name: updateDispatchTableFull_
methods.description: Performs a full update of the dispatch table for all keys.

methods.name: checkInvariants
methods.description: Checks internal consistency of the OperatorEntry state.

methods.name: listAllDispatchKeys
methods.description: Lists all dispatch keys with registered kernels.

methods.name: reportSignatureError
methods.description: Reports an error when signatures do not match.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Reports an error for a dispatch key, with detailed message.

methods.name: dumpComputedTable
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current computed dispatch table.

methods.name: setReportErrorCallback_
methods.description: Sets a callback for error reporting.

methods.name: dumpState
methods.description: Returns a string with the internal state of the OperatorEntry for debugging.
